notes.title: v0.8.3.4 - Endless Mode Update
notes.notes:
Remember how last update I switch endless mode and new character update? Well, I actually did both on this update!



Huge thanks to all the playtesters that helped me find bugs on the experimental branch!



TL;DR: new endless mode with online leaderboard, 1 new character, 18 new relics, 4 new arrows, 19 new achievements, new music, new capsule art, characters and relics rework/balancing, optimizations and more!


New trailer[previewyoutube="Xu1RGr9pRUs;full"][/previewyoutube]

Endless mode
New endless mode is here!

After winning a run, you can continue it and score in an online leaderboard.

Every loops will makes the game harder, but most of the relics are stackable now, that means there's a lot of ways to break the game.


New character: Dave the plague doctor
Dave is specialized in debris buff/damage: 

Starts with "Plague Nose" Relic: "When an enemy is hit by a debris, either give him a random negative status or give you a random positive status. Strength is divided by 3."

Unlocked by: "Win a fight without shooting enemies directly (at least 3+ enemies)"


18 new relics
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864064/0f9e5a1d55f4fc150ee529d06201a67696e5a679.png"]


4 new arrows
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864064/71222b59e6ed67d28326a481e37c9871b6e9db7b.png"]


Balancing and Characters rework
24 relics and 3 arrows have been buff/nerf thanks to the analytics that was put in place last update.

Elliot, Pete and Vega characters have been reworked entirely to make their builds more unique than before.

(more info in the complete changelog below or directly in game)


Optimization
All optimization issues are finally fixed!

On my computer I'm always above 60 fps. If you still have some issues, please contact me!


Others
19 new achievements, quality-of-life, new display and animations for relics, map finally on the good layer, ...


New music and capsule art
New music composed by Will O Wisp.

New painted capsule art by Gongor G.


What next?
In the roadmap, available in game, I've put "???"' for the next update. That's because I don't know yet what I'll do.

You can still expect the usual content drop and I'll maybe add some new levels along with some improvement on the dialogues/events (maybe it's time to contact a writer?). I'll see!


Complete changelog:# v0.8.3.0 - Endless Mode + New Character + Content Drop + HUGE Balancing
\[Add]

- Add endless mode with an online leaderboard to compete against other players

- \[Character] "Dave (Plague Doctor)":

    - Starts with "Plague Nose" Relic: "When an enemy is hit by a debris, either give him a random negative status or give you a random positive status Strength is divided by 3."

    - Unlocked by: "Win a fight without shooting enemies directly (at least 3+ enemies)"

- \[Arrow] Add "Consecutive Arrow": S:30/40/50 P:2/3/4 Give Consecutive 1/2/3 to the next arrow

- \[Arrow] Add "Mirror Arrow": S:30/40/50 P:2/3/4 Give Mirror 1/2/3 to the next arrow

- \[Arrow] Add "Full Gold Arrow": S:-1 P:2/4/6 When retrieving coins from platforms, amount is doubled

- \[Arrow] Add "Ghost Money Arrow": S:-1 P:-1 Add 1/2/3 coin to platform when passing through (Ghost, Fragile 1)

- \[Relic] Add "Cursed Strength Ring" Relic: "All enemies starts with strength 5 but you have +5 piercing"

- \[Relic] Add "Cursed Shield Ring" Relic: "All enemies starts with shield 30 but you have +2 piercing"

- \[Relic] Add "Stick Scepter" Relic: "At the start of combat, give Piercing 10 if you have only 1 arrow in your inventory"

- \[Relic] Add "Piercing Belt" Relic: "Last arrow of the quiver have +5 piercing"

- \[Relic] Add "Strength Belt" Relic: "Last arrow of the quiver have +50 strength"

- \[Relic] Add "Strength Cowboy Hat" Relic: "First arrow of the quiver have +50 strength"

- Platforms can now hold multiple coins



\[Balancing]

- \[Relic] Buff "Ankh" Relic: Gives (5 -> 10) coins when an arrow is discarded

- \[Relic] Nerf "Big knight helmet" Relic: Give 10 shield instead of 2 but can only be played 5 times per combat and platform destroyed goal increment every time it is used

- \[Relic] Buff "Broken lighthouse" Relic: Have -1 choice of arrows before shooting, Give +(3 -> 5) piercing

- \[Relic] Nerf "Broken mirror" Relic: Give multi-arrow (3 -> 2)

- \[Relic] Buff "Broken Shield" Relic: 100% chances to trigger instead of 50%

- \[Relic] Buff "Copper chestplate" Relic: Give Thorns (5 -> 10) at the start of each combat

- \[Relic] Nerf "Essence of life" Relic: Give +1 Max HP every 50 platforms destroyed and platform destroyed goal increment by 2 every time it is used and can be used only 1 time per combat

- \[Relic] Buff "Gold chestplate" Relic: Give Thorns (2 -> 5) every 10 platforms destroyed and can only be used 5 times per turn

- \[Relic] Buff "Gold helmet" Relic: Gives Gold Shield (3 -> 15) at the start of each combat (Now Rare instead of Common)

- \[Relic] Buff "Gold quiver" Relic: Give (5 -> 10) coins every time your quiver is reloaded

- \[Relic] Nerf "Grapes" Relic: Max 5 times per turn

- \[Relic] Nerf "Health bow" Relic: Max 5 times per combat

- \[Relic] Buff "Iron chestplate" Relic: When receiving Thorns, get +(1 -> 5)

- \[Relic] Buff "Silver crate" Relic: Max 5 times per turn

notes.title: v0.8.3.0 - Endless Mode and new Character Update in the experimental branch
notes.notes:
Remember how last update I switched endless mode and new character update? Well, I actually did both on this new update!

There's the new endless mode with an online leaderboard, 1 new character, 18 new relics, 4 new arrows, new music, new capsule art, characters and relics rework/balancing, new animations/polish, and way more!

(You can see the changelog directly in game)



You can test it right now in the experimental branch:

Go to your Steam library -> Right click on Arrogue -> Properties -> Betas -> Beta Participation -> Choose "experimental"

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864064/bcccece2ffe362827d423c317863864abed93920.png"]

I'm looking for some feedback in discord (or steam forum):

Is the new endless mode fun? Is it too easy or too hard?

Characters have been reworked to have more predefined builds for each, do you feel it's the case?

Does the game feels more balanced? There's more way to break the game right now, is it a good idea?

Don't hesitate to share any other thoughts and to report bugs!



Usually I make the public release on the 1st of each month, but this one will take longer to be playtested as I need to make sure everything is working fine with the endless mode. I'm planning to make it public between 5-15 August, be sure to give me some feedback if you want to see it sooner!



Note: the leaderboard will be reset once in the public branch (and might be reset later during early access)



(please don't shoot consecutive arrows after another consecutive arrows, I need to add a cap (do it, it is fun))

notes.title: v0.8.1.0 - QOL Update + April Content Drop
notes.notes:
The goal of this update is to add some Quality Of Life features that were missing!
For example: displaying all upgrade levels of arrows, increasing readability of health bar and statuses, tooltip on platforms, improving the tooltip, bugfixes, balancing etc

And also the monthly Content Drop with 10 new relics and 3 new arrows (1 free arrow, lucky you!)

There's also a new mechanic: You can now discard arrows from your quiver before each shot!

Hope you'll enjoy!
And be sure to leave a review on steam to support me!


Here's the complete changelog:
v0.8.1.0 - QOL Update + April Content Drop

Add
- Add discard mechanic: you can now discard arrow(s) before each shot, if done you will receive "Stunned 1". If you have "Immune" status you can counter it and load/discard another arrow.
- Add "Piercing Shield Arrow" S:-1 P:0 Add your shield amount divided by 20/15/10 to the arrow piercing stat but remove all your shield on shoot
- Add "Bag of Strength Arrow" S:0 P:-1 Gives 10 strength per 25 coins you have but remove 30/20/15% of your total coins on shoot
- Add "Bag of Piercing Arrow" S:-1 P:0 Gives 1 piercing per 50 coins you have but remove 30/20/15% of your total coins on shoot
- Add "Egyptian Scepter" relic: Upgrading arrow is cheaper
- Add "Red Dice" relic: First reroll in treasure room and combat reward is free
- Add "Tent" relic: One item in the shop is free
- Add "Broken Piercing" relic: Gives +2 piercing every time an arrow is discarded (reset at the end of combat)
- Add "Broken Strength" relic: Gives +20 strength every time an arrow is discarded (reset at the end of combat)
- Add "Broken Health" relic: Heal 10 HP every 5 discards
- Add "Broken Shield" relic: Has 50% chance to give 20 shield every time an arrow is discarded
- Add "Ankh" relic: Gives 5 coins when an arrow is discarded
- Add "Piercing Ring" relic: Every 5 turns, your current arrow have +10 piercing but 0 strength
- Add "Stun Ring" relic: Gives Stunned 1 to every enemies every 5 turns (reset at the end of combat)
- ???

QOL

- Add question mark on arrows and relics not discovered yet (on shop/rewards/treasure)
- Add version number + experimental tag on main menu and run summary
- Add icons to some buttons
- Add simple loading screen before each run
- Improve difficulty tooltip to display all difficulties instead of "apply previous difficulties"
- Improve egghead and target description
- Display sub-statuses in some tooltip (for "Gold Piercing", "Gold Strength" and "Gold Shield")
- Improve dialogues punctuation
- Add option to Hide/Display the choice of arrow to see the board (before shooting)
- Improve treasure chest display

- Fix remove arrow button in shop that was clickable without enough money

- Fix a bug where some animations could get stuck because they were reaching tween's limit

notes.title: v0.7.4 - Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Arrogue is finally releasing in Early access after 1 year of developement!

It has been a crazy year for me, I've put all my energy working on this game and I'm so happy for the support you guys gave me in return. I want to thanks all the playtesters, the people from the community and all the players.

Arrogue is still a little rough in the edges but I'm very happy with the result so far!
During early access I want to balance the game, improve the difficulty curve and of course add more content. I will soon announce the early access roadmap.

I hope you'll enjoy playing the full version as much as I'm enjoying working on this game.

- Add 11 new status (Gold shield, Gold sword, Gold piercing, Piercing, Softness, Dodge, Reflection, Thorn, Tipsy, Regenerate, Insensitive)
- Add 20 new relics (Lighthouse, Carrot, Blue cape, Purple cape, Chestplate, Silver chestplate, Gold chestplate, Cheese, White cheese, Blue helmet, Gold helmet, Knight helmet, Broken Lighthouse, Wine, Weird watermelon, Weird bread, Weird sandwich, Broken mirror, Flail, Cherry, Essence of life)
- Add 9 new arrows (Cure arrow, Antidote arrow, Heal arrow, Regenerate arrow, Dodge arrow, Reflection arrow, Tipsy arrow, Thorns arrow, Thorns destruction arrow)
- Add quiver's selection to be able to select between the 2 first arrow before shooting (number can increase or decrease with relics)
- Add Foreground and Background covers to structures

[Deletions]
- Remove all existing levels, cluster and structures due to combat's system changes
- Remove Explosive arrow, Explosive platform and Explosive Hammer relic (need better game design, might come back later)
- Remove Ghost platform, Ghost Healing Potion relic, Ghost Shard relic, Tombstone relic (need better game design, might come back later)
